**Ekkokardiografi** (echocardiography) is a diagnostic medical intervention utilized within the Danish healthcare system to evaluate patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]]. As part of the national quality assurance framework overseen by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), the procedure is essential for determining the structural and functional status of the heart in these patients.

The intervention serves as the foundational metric for [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], a clinical quality indicator that tracks the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who receive an echocardiogram within a strict clinical window: from six months prior to three months following their initial diagnosis date [^src2], [^src4]. To ensure high-quality care, the national standard mandates that at least 80% (≥ 80%) of eligible patients must undergo this examination within the specified timeframe [^src1]. 

To accurately measure compliance with this standard, the Danish health registries—specifically the National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret) and the National Health Service Register (Sygesikringsregisteret)—track the procedure using a comprehensive set of codes [^src4]. These codes capture various modalities of the examination. For instance, transthoracic echocardiography is coded as [[uxuc80]], while transesophageal examinations are tracked under codes like [[uxuc81]] and [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]] [^src4]. Other specific variations, including stress tests and standard or advanced investigations, are logged under distinct identifiers such as [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]], [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], and [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]] [^src4]. This extensive coding schema ensures that all valid diagnostic ultrasound examinations of the heart are correctly attributed to the patient's care pathway for national quality reporting.

## Claims

### quality-standard
- Indikator 2 har standarden ≥ 80 % for andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, der har fået udført ekkokardiografi fra 6 måneder før til 3 måneder efter 1. diagnosedato [^src1]

### clinical-indicator
- Indikator 2: Ekkokardiografi: Andel af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, der har fået udført ekkokardiografi fra 6 måneder før til 3 måneder efter 1. diagnosedato [^src1]

### quality-indicator
- Indikator 2 måler andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, der har fået udført ekkokardiografi fra 6 måneder før til 3 måneder efter 1. diagnosedato [^src1]

### definition
- For indikator 2 er tælleren patienter i nævneren som har fået udført ekkokardiografi inden for tidsrammen 6 måneder før til 3 måneder efter 1. diagnosedato [^src1]
